ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal overflow on 390px mobile: the Begin Confidential Safety Assessment button is 387px wide (text uses whitespace-nowrap + px-8) producing scrollWidth 403 vs clientWidth 390. The three cards stack correctly, but the long non-wrapping button pushes the viewport. Fix suggestions: either wrap the button in a block/full-width container at the sm breakpoint, remove whitespace-nowrap for this CTA, shorten copy ('Begin Safety Assessment'), or add max-w-full with text wrapping.

rca of the issue: Mobile overflow RCA: SafetyHub.jsx line 54 renders <Button size='lg' className='h-12 rounded-full ... px-8 text-base font-bold'>Begin Confidential Safety Assessment</Button>. shadcn Button has `whitespace-nowrap` by default. On a 390px viewport the main container contributes 32px of px-4 padding (16+16), leaving 358px, but the button content (text + px-8 = 64px padding) measures 387px and refuses to wrap, so document.documentElement.scrollWidth=403 > clientWidth=390. Reproduce: emulate 390x844 viewport, visit /joint/{rid}/safety, run document.documentElement.scrollWidth. Mitigation: add `whitespace-normal` + `w-full max-w-xs mx-auto` to the button, or shorten copy to 'Begin Safety Assessment', or wrap button text in a span with break-words.
